organization_routing.finding: Clinical portal navigation (/clinical, /clinical/overview, /clinical/patients, /dashboard, /council, /scribe) audited. Pre-existing routes used static mock patients without organization context. Integrated OrganizationSwitcher in header strip and OrganizationLinkBadge in patient dossier inspector, preserving existing 123 routes.

organization_switcher.finding: Distinguished WorkspaceSwitcher (role/persona switching: Personal, Clinical, Research, Admin) from OrganizationSwitcher (multi-tenant B2B clinic / hospital switching). OrganizationSwitcher uses ChromeSurface overlay, accessible ARIA attributes, Escape key handling, and 1-click active tenant switching with automated cache purging.

tenant_context_boundary.finding: Implemented organization-context.ts and OrganizationProvider. Enforces clearOrganizationScopedClientState() upon organization switch to purge clara_org_cache:* and clara_tenant_cache:* keys, preventing cross-tenant leakage. Automatically attaches X-CLARA-Organization-Id in http-client.ts and ApiV2Client.

provider_patient_linking.finding: Implemented OrganizationLinkBadge surfacing hospital/clinic affiliation, CCHN practitioner certification code (e.g. CCHN: 014829/HCM-CCHN), clinic tier (Hospital, Clinic, Practice, Facility), and EMR sync status across patient dossier and clinical command workflows.
